Author: Vykuntaraju K Gowda et al.

Title: A randomized controlled trial on comparison of phenobarbitone and levetiracetam for the treatment of neonatal seizures: pilot study
Author: Perveen et al.
Comment: The table lists levetiracetam first, so it is retained as group 1 and identified as the active control; phenobarbitone is group 2 and is the synthesis treatment. Infants could cross over after nonresponse, but the paper states that analysis was intention-to-treat and the denominators are the 30 infants originally randomized per arm. The paper does not report a mortality risk ratio; calculate the planned phenobarbitone/levetiracetam RR downstream from the extracted counts. The reported RR of 0.27 (0.09–0.63) applies to seizure control, not mortality, and was not extracted.
